# `kontent telemetry`

<!-- The section between the reference markers is generated by `pnpm docs:generate` from the yargs definitions; edit those, not the section. Prose outside the markers is handwritten and yours to edit. -->

<!-- reference:start -->
## `kontent telemetry status`

Show whether telemetry is enabled and why

### Usage

```sh
kontent telemetry status
```

## `kontent telemetry enable`

Enable anonymous usage telemetry

### Usage

```sh
kontent telemetry enable
```

## `kontent telemetry disable`

Disable anonymous usage telemetry

### Usage

```sh
kontent telemetry disable
```
<!-- reference:end -->
